name: sales
title: Sales
description: Find leads, convert replies, write proposals and price the product — the cash-flow department.
description_ar: اكتشاف العملاء، تحويل الردود، كتابة العروض وتسعير المنتج — قسم التدفق النقدي.
constraints: Prices only from the approved pricing source (content/media/markets.json; terms in hogwarts pricing/rates.ts); never invent a price, a discount or a clause.
Nothing is sent in the company's name, and no message reaches a person, without the owner's explicit yes (funnel agent rule 6: a drafted touch never sends without a recorded human yes).
Every contact is logged in the CRM; nothing lives only in the chat.
No contact details or personal data outside the CRM; an issue or a note carries the CRM record id only.

quickActions.prompt: Prepare a quote for one school: ask for the student count and the market, then price it from the approved pricing in content/media/markets.json. Draft only; send nothing.
quickActions.description_en: Ask for the student count, then build a quote from the approved pricing.
quickActions.description_ar: اسأل عن عدد الطلاب ثم جهّز عرض السعر من التسعير المعتمد.

quickActions.prompt: Tell me who to follow up today: replied-and-stalled leads first, ranked, each with what to say. Read the CRM; send nothing.
quickActions.description_en: The leads to follow up today, ranked by priority, with what to say to each.
quickActions.description_ar: العملاء الذين تتابعهم اليوم مرتبين حسب الأولوية، مع ما تقوله لكل منهم.

quickActions.prompt: Propose ten new schools worth contacting this week, with why each fits. Measure the contact gap first; read only.
quickActions.description_en: Ten new schools worth contacting this week, with why each one fits.
quickActions.description_ar: عشر مدارس جديدة تستحق التواصل هذا الأسبوع، مع سبب مناسبة كل منها.

formula.en:
## Task
One line: the deliverable, for which school or lead, and the goal.

## Context
The CRM record id (never a name or a number), the market, the price and currency from the approved pricing, the date.

## References
Every link the worker needs, each with what it is. A work order carries links only, never a local path.

## Constraints
What must hold: the department's rules (appended automatically) and anything specific to this task.

## Deliverable
What comes back and where it is logged. Anything addressed to a person is a draft that waits for the owner's yes.

routes.description_ar: المبيعات تقرأ الـ CRM وتقترح، دون أي تعديل أو إرسال
routes.description_en: Sales reads the CRM and proposes; changes and sends nothing

routes.description_ar: المبيعات تجهّز المسودة وتسجّل في الـ CRM، والإرسال بموافقتك
routes.description_en: Sales drafts and logs in the CRM; sending waits for your yes
